    Residual quotient translations of a normal-subgroup orbit category #

    Let N ◁ G. A chosen representative of each coset in G / N determines an ambient translation functor of the N-shift-orbit category. This file constructs the residual unit and product isomorphisms. They combine the canonical coset-comparison isomorphisms with the coherent unit and product isomorphisms for fixed ambient translations.
